description: A box (19.406349006155267 by 12.037736798070128 by 18.558311874909336) cut in one call by two skew cylinders that meet inside it, then the first face pressed out by 0.05 (the multi-tool property a_multi_tool_result_is_an_operand_of_every_operation at the fixed seed 61727269732d70726f70657274792d74657374732d736565642d763100000000 and 1000 cases, CI run 37582971995, shard 1, shrunk): offset_faces returns a body that fails the checker (a vertex 3.8e-2 off its edge's curve, pcurves jumping 8.6e-3 in (u, v)), where the chain of the two cuts offsets clean. The desired result is a checker-green body that matches Open CASCADE's.
